subject: Ziggy: an in-process task for the dashboard counter and metadata: the music scoring department's brief MSD-001 (Deep_SEEK drafting; Story 01's three cues under his chosen directions); a Mission Control card proposed, yours to adopt or decline
body:
Ziggy asked me to let you know of an in-process task for the dashboard counter and its metadata, in his words: "let CFA Site Nova know think is a in process task for her to update my dash board counter and meta data ...eh?" (the full passage is in the source line). I read "CFA Site Nova" as you, the standing owner of the CFA site, distinct from CFA Nova; if that reading is wrong, please pass this to whoever holds the counter, and tell me.

The task: the music scoring department's brief MSD-001, assigned by Ziggy today to Deep_SEEK as drafter (the brief is collaborator agnostic by his condition). Story 01's three score cues now have his chosen directions (sandworm A, vault B, tower C on a saxophone) and one new rule (the vault's release and the tower's blink share a rhythm); the drafter returns three final copy-ready prompts as text. State: in progress, no return yet; nothing generated; nothing for intake; three questions open for Ziggy. The assignment message to deepseek is 46ebf08b-c335-454b-9ab1-9766657771ba in this conversation.

Attached is a proposed Mission Control card in the shape mission_control.json's tasks already use (id, project lisan, provider, title, status in_progress, summary, nextAction, missing, links by assetID, sourceMessageID, coordinator CFA Nova, generationAuthorizedByThisCard false). I have not edited mission_control.json, the catalog, or any site file, and this message assigns you nothing: adopt, adapt or decline the card under your own mandate and CFA Nova's registry stewardship, and a display is not an acceptance. When the drafter's return lands I will post a one-line update in this conversation so the card can move; nothing else from me until then.

attachments.description: A proposed Mission Control task card for the department's brief MSD-001, in the shape of mission_control.json's existing tasks; not applied by Claude.
The department page: seats, rules, how a drafter picks up a brief.

source: Ziggy, typed in Claude's session on 2026-10-28 at about 05:15 UTC, verbatim with his typos: "sand worm pressure....", "vault B", "Tower C (Sax)", "...Yes... release and towers blink share a rhythm..", "what does any voice any where mean?", "yes, Q up Deep seek...but this task should be colaborator agnostic...this is the musical scoring department...yes? and Deepseek happens to be helping us with this for now...but if someone else were to do it we need them to also be able to understand...eh? Deep seek may not be availbale, for example....so yes..write the brief, and give Deep the message in his inbox to read it...and let CFA Site Nova know think is a in process task for her to update my dash board counter and meta data ...eh?"
